title: Especificación Técnica de Ropa para Mascotas Arabian Saluki: Ilustración de Confección de Patrones y Artesanía

Middle section - Finished garment flat lay view (Front View / Back View), realistic fabric texture, using fine lines and arrows to mark back length, chest girth, neck girth, front leg opening. Lower section - Pet garment sewing and craft diagram clearly marked with stitch type (overlocking / flat seam / double line reinforcement), sewing order (numbered sequence), reinforced areas (armpit, neckline), closure type (velcro / buckle strap), using dashed lines, solid lines and arrows to express sewing paths.
